text: yajamānasuttaṃ [922] ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate . atha kho sakko devānamindo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi . [923] ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho sakko devānamindo bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi yajamānānaṃ manussānaṃ puññapekkhāna pāṇinaṃ karotaṃ opadhikaṃ puññaṃ kattha dinnaṃ mahapphalanti . [924] cattāro ca paṭipannā cattāro ca phale ṭhitā esa saṅgho ujubhūto paññāsīlasamāhito yajamānānaṃ manussānaṃ puññapekkhāna pāṇinaṃ karotaṃ opadhikaṃ puññaṃ saṅghe dinnaṃ mahapphalanti . sattamaṃ
